import sys, json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def to_float(x, nd=2):
    return float(round(float(x), nd))

def main():
    path = sys.argv[1]
    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None:
            return
        try:
            if pd.isna(value):
                return
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            pass
        facts.append({
            "entity": entity,
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": to_float(value, 1 if metric in ("share", "WoW", "YoY") or period in ("WoW", "YoY") else 2),
            "formula": formula
        })

    # ---- TOTALS ----
    rev_tw_sum = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw_sum = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_ly_sum = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True) if df["Revenue_LY"].notna().any() else np.nan
    units_tw_sum = df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    units_lw_sum = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    orders_tw_sum = df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    orders_lw_sum = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)

    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", rev_tw_sum, "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", rev_lw_sum, "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    if not pd.isna(rev_ly_sum):
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", rev_ly_sum, "sum(Revenue_LY)")

    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", units_tw_sum, "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "LW", units_lw_sum, "sum(Units_LW)")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", orders_tw_sum, "sum(Orders_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "LW", orders_lw_sum, "sum(Orders_LW)")

    if rev_lw_sum and not pd.isna(rev_lw_sum) and rev_lw_sum != 0:
        wow_total = (rev_tw_sum - rev_lw_sum) / rev_lw_sum * 100
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", wow_total,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")

    if not pd.isna(rev_ly_sum) and rev_ly_sum != 0:
        yoy_total = (rev_tw_sum - rev_ly_sum) / rev_ly_sum * 100
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", yoy_total,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")

    # ---- TOP ENTITY (Rank 1) ----
    if "Rank" in df.columns and df["Rank"].notna().any():
        top_row = df.loc[df["Rank"].idxmin()]
        add(top_row["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", top_row["Revenue_TW"],
            "Revenue_TW for top-ranked entity")
        add(top_row["Entity"], "share", "TW", top_row["Share_Pct"],
            "Share_Pct for top-ranked entity")
        add(top_row["Entity"], "rank", "TW", top_row["Rank"],
            "Rank by Revenue_TW")

    # ---- PER-ENTITY SHARE & RANK ----
    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        if pd.notna(row.get("Share_Pct")):
            add(row["Entity"], "share", "TW", row["Share_Pct"],
                "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
        if pd.notna(row.get("Rank")):
            add(row["Entity"], "rank", "TW", row["Rank"],
                "Rank by Revenue_TW descending")

    # ---- BIGGEST WoW MOVERS ----
    if df["WoW_Pct"].notna().any():
        max_wow_row = df.loc[df["WoW_Pct"].idxmax()]
        min_wow_row = df.loc[df["WoW_Pct"].idxmin()]
        add(max_wow_row["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", max_wow_row["WoW_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (largest increase)")
        add(min_wow_row["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", min_wow_row["WoW_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100 (largest decrease)")

    # ---- BIGGEST YoY MOVERS ----
    if df["YoY_Pct"].notna().any():
        max_yoy_row = df.loc[df["YoY_Pct"].idxmax()]
        min_yoy_row = df.loc[df["YoY_Pct"].idxmin()]
        add(max_yoy_row["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", max_yoy_row["YoY_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100 (largest increase)")
        add(min_yoy_row["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", min_yoy_row["YoY_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100 (largest decrease)")

    # Cap to 25 facts
    facts = facts[:25]

    print(json.dumps(facts))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
